description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Software Engineer with a generalist's range and a real interest in frontend engineering. You will join a platform team that makes it faster, safer, and more consistent for everyone at the company to build software. That covers the interfaces people use, the shared tooling behind them, and the workflows that carry an idea through to shipped, validated code.



You'll work on a mix of problems across the stack. You'll take on well-scoped projects with growing independence, learn from experienced engineers, and ship work that other teams use every day. We want someone who is curious and eager to grow, and who cares about quality.



We're building in an AI-native world. You should be comfortable working with agents while still caring about code quality. We see agents as a chance to help the whole company build better, safer code.

 


AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

 - Contribute to internal platforms and tooling that help people and agents move from a task or idea to fully validated, production-ready code. These platforms serve both internal and external users, and over time will serve roles across the product development lifecycle.

 - Build and improve frontend components, shared libraries, and design system tooling used across many products.

 - Help make design system usage more accurate and efficient for engineers and AI agents, through better tooling, documentation, and guidance.

 - Build automation that keeps design assets and production code in sync, and reduces manual handoff between design and engineering.

 - Help modernize and decouple legacy applications and shared infrastructure, so teams can develop and ship faster.

 - Partner with product engineers and designers to understand their needs, gather feedback, and turn it into reusable solutions.

 - Write clear design documents and contribute to technical decisions with your team.

 - Uphold strong engineering practices, including testing, code review, accessibility, performance, and documentation.


WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field

 - 3 + years of experience

 - Experience building web applications with TypeScript and a component-based framework such as React, and a genuine interest in deepening your frontend expertise.

 - Solid software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, code review, and CI/CD.

 - Ability to take well-scoped problems from design through delivery, and to seek out guidance when you need it.

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, and comfort working with cross-functional users and teams.

 - Curiosity about, and hands-on use of, AI coding tools and agent-based workflows.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience contributing to a design system or shared component library.

 - Experience with build, packaging, or developer tooling.

 - Experience building automation or developer-experience workflows.

 - Experience building interfaces for AI or agent-driven products.

 - Experience with data visualization, charting, or map and graphics rendering in the browser.

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
